photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The park in the morning: a path of tiles with a granite curb, a low square white lamp at its side, two women on the path, a granite bench, clipped hedges along the paths, round clipped bushes, granite balls on the lawn, frangipani trees, a black post with white globes, raised lawns and coconut palms.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The park in the morning: a round flower bed with a ring of red leaves and low yellow green plants in it, a low square white lamp, clipped hedges and round clipped bushes, painted cat sculptures, frangipani trees, coconut palms, a black post with white globes, a blue lamp pole far away.

photos.shows: Benches of the park: a bench of dark polished granite (a slab on two slab legs) and benches of rough light granite, by a path of red tiles and a clipped hedge; a dark post with white globes.
